text: …じゃ　おきゃく　さんに　おこられるか？

structure.jp: おきゃく　さんに　おこられるか？
structure.en: will I get scolded by the guests?

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The られる ending says the thing is done to you by someone else. おこられる = 'get told off'.

patterns.name: 〜に (doer)
patterns.span: おきゃく　さんに　おこられる
patterns.explanation: With a verb of having something done to you, に shows who does it. おきゃく さんに おこられる = 'get told off by the guests'.

patterns.name: 〜では
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the spoken short form of では, 'with that' or 'if it's that', pointing back at the dish he just named. じゃ = 'with that'.
